data.title: 摩根 · 冬宫晴光羊毛地毯
data.description: 冬宫高大透光穹顶下，明亮雪霁阳光倾泻在厚实纯白羊毛地毯上，摩根银白长发铺展，斜倚凝视，冰蓝眼眸化为对夫婿无尽的深情，无瑕雪肤与优美起伏的王后胴体在明澈天光中圣洁晶莹。
data.action: 雪霁阳光前羊毛地毯上斜倚凝视
data.lighting: 高窗倾泻的透亮晨曦与银雪天光
data.camera: medium shot, reclining gracefully on white wool rug in sunlit winter palace dome
data.promptProse: Morgan reclines on the white wool rug, black silk mantle at her waist, looking toward the viewer. Snow-softened morning light descends through the high palace windows.
data.animaCaption: The silk mantle rests at her waist on the white wool rug.
